title: Speculative Forking: Turning Idle Wait into Parallel Exploration for Repository Environment Setup
title_zh: 投机式分叉：将空闲等待转化为并行探索，用于仓库环境搭建

paragraphs.en: Before developers can use a software project, they must first get it to run. This often requires installing the right language runtime, system packages, build tools, and test commands. Recent LLM-based agents automate environment setup by inspecting a repository, writing setup scripts, running them, and repairing the resulting errors. However, these agents still follow a sequential trial-and-error loop: they try one setup route, wait for slow commands to finish, observe the failure, and only then decide what to try next. Because environment commands often take long to run, this sequential workflow makes setup slow and limits exploration to one route at a time.
paragraphs.zh: 在开发者能够使用一个软件项目之前，必须先让它运行起来。 这通常需要安装正确的语言运行时、系统软件包、构建工具和测试命令。 近年来基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过检查代码仓库、编写环境配置脚本、运行这些脚本并修复产生的错误，实现了环境搭建的自动化。 然而，这些智能体仍然遵循一个顺序的试错循环：它们先尝试一条配置路径，等待缓慢的命令执行完毕，观察失败结果，然后才决定下一步尝试什么。 由于环境相关的命令往往耗时较长，这种顺序式的工作流使环境搭建变得缓慢，并且每次只能探索一条路径。

paragraphs.en: We present SpecBuild , an LLM-based environment setup system designed to be both faster and more successful through speculative forking. SpecBuild explores candidate setup branches in parallel, returns the first committed environment, and discards the rest. It applies this design at two granularities: strategy-level forking explores alternative setup routes, such as different base images and dependency policies, while command-level forking predicts failures of running commands and prepares repair branches before those failures are observed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 SpecBuild，一个基于大语言模型的环境搭建系统，通过投机式分叉（speculative forking）实现更快且更成功的环境搭建。 SpecBuild 并行探索多个候选搭建分支，返回第一个提交完成的环境，并丢弃其余分支。 它在两个粒度上应用这一设计：策略级分叉探索不同的搭建路径，例如不同的基础镜像和依赖策略；而命令级分叉预测正在运行的命令的失败情况，并在这些失败被观测到之前准备好修复分支。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SpecBuild on Multi-Docker-Eval, covering 334 tasks from 40 repositories and 9 programming languages. Across three backbone models, SpecBuild improves the success rate by 6.4 to 12.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline, while reducing average setup time by 22.4% to 41.6%. These results show that LLM-based environment setup need not trade speed for reliability: parallel speculative exploration can make agents both faster and more successful.

paragraphs.en: Before developers can modify, test, debug, or reuse a software project, they must first get it to run. Running a project’s tests is central to validating code changes in both development and software-engineering research [ 1 ] . This requires matching language runtimes, system packages, build tools, environment variables, and test commands to the project at hand. Containerization makes this setup explicit through artifacts such as Dockerfiles, which have been widely studied as software-engineering and DevOps artifacts [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Yet writing these artifacts remains difficult: developers report Docker and Docker-Compose specifications as time-consuming, and prior work observes that they require system-administration knowledge and project-specific adaptation [ 5 , 2 , 6 ] . Environment setup is therefore a practical bottleneck for developers before they can run tests, reproduce bugs, or validate fixes.
paragraphs.zh: 在开发者能够修改、测试、调试或复用一个软件项目之前，他们必须首先让项目运行起来。 运行项目的测试是验证代码变更的核心环节，无论是在开发中还是在软件工程研究中都是如此 [ 1 ] 。 这需要为当前项目匹配相应的语言运行时、系统软件包、构建工具、环境变量和测试命令。 容器化通过诸如 Dockerfile 之类的制品使这一配置过程显式化，这类制品作为软件工程和 DevOps 制品已被广泛研究 [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。 然而编写这些制品仍然很困难：开发者反映 Docker 和 Docker-Compose 规范的编写非常耗时，且已有研究观察到它们需要系统管理知识以及针对具体项目的适配 [ 5 , 2 , 6 ] 。 因此，环境配置成为开发者在运行测试、复现缺陷或验证修复之前面临的实际瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: This bottleneck is amplified by recent efforts to make software-engineering tasks verifiable at scale. Benchmarks and training pipelines for coding agents require executable environments in which tests can be run against real repositories [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] . Recent systems now scale this construction to tens of thousands or even millions of environments [ 13 , 14 ] . In this setting, setup time is no longer a one-time inconvenience: each failed or slow construction attempt becomes a recurring wall-clock cost for evaluation, data generation, and developer workflows.

paragraphs.en: Recent work has started to automate environment setup with LLM-based agents. These agents inspect repository files, generate setup scripts, run them in containers, read execution errors, and revise the scripts until the tests pass or a budget is exhausted [ 15 , 1 , 16 ] . Newer systems broaden this automation across languages, repositories, and training-data pipelines [ 17 , 18 , 16 ] . This feedback-driven loop also appears in broader software-engineering agents, which execute tools, observe feedback, and use that feedback to plan later actions [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] . In environment setup, however, the loop is typically sequential: the agent tries one setup route, waits for slow commands such as package installation, dependency resolution, and compilation to finish, observes the result, and only then decides what to try next [ 15 , 1 , 16 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 近期的工作已开始利用基于大语言模型的智能体自动化环境搭建。 这些智能体会检查仓库文件、生成搭建脚本、在容器中运行这些脚本、读取执行错误，并不断修改脚本，直到测试通过或预算耗尽 [ 15 , 1 , 16 ] 。 较新的系统将这种自动化扩展到多种语言、仓库和训练数据流水线 [ 17 , 18 , 16 ] 。 这种由反馈驱动的循环也出现在更广泛的软件工程智能体中，它们执行工具、观察反馈，并利用该反馈来规划后续动作 [ 19 , 20 , 21 ] 。 然而在环境搭建中，这一循环通常是串行的：智能体先尝试一条搭建路径，等待诸如包安装、依赖解析和编译等耗时命令完成，观察结果，然后才决定下一步尝试什么 [ 15 , 1 , 16 ] 。

sents.en: Recent work has started to automate environment setup with LLM-based agents.
sents.zh: 近期的工作已开始利用基于大语言模型的智能体自动化环境搭建。

sents.en: In environment setup, however, the loop is typically sequential: the agent tries one setup route, waits for slow commands such as package installation, dependency resolution, and compilation to finish, observes the result, and only then decides what to try next [ 15 , 1 , 16 ] .
sents.zh: 然而在环境搭建中，这一循环通常是串行的：智能体先尝试一条搭建路径，等待诸如包安装、依赖解析和编译等耗时命令完成，观察结果，然后才决定下一步尝试什么 [ 15 , 1 , 16 ] 。

paragraphs.en: This sequential structure exposes two uncertainties in environment setup. First, the agent faces route uncertainty: it does not know which setup route, including choices such as the base image, runtime, package manager, and dependency policy, will build the repository. A sequential loop can validate only one route at a time, so failed routes consume time and iteration budget before other plausible routes are tried. Second, the agent faces command-outcome uncertainty: slow setup commands may fail, but a sequential loop waits for the failure before preparing a repair. Together, these uncertainties couple wall-clock time and success: slow feedback makes each trial expensive, and one-route-at-a-time search limits how broadly the agent can explore.
paragraphs.zh: 这种顺序结构暴露了环境搭建中的两个不确定性。 首先，智能体面临路线不确定性：它不知道哪种搭建路线——包括基础镜像、运行时、包管理器和依赖策略等选择——能够成功构建该仓库。 顺序循环一次只能验证一条路线，因此在尝试其他可行路线之前，失败的路线会消耗时间和迭代预算。 其次，智能体面临命令结果不确定性：耗时的搭建命令可能会失败，但顺序循环必须等待失败发生后才能准备修复。 这两个不确定性共同将实际耗时与成功耦合在一起：缓慢的反馈使每次尝试的代价高昂，而一次只尝试一条路线的搜索限制了智能体探索的广度。

paragraphs.en: Environment setup is a developer-facing problem before it is a benchmark abstraction. Before developers can modify, test, or reproduce a project, they must first install the right language runtime, system packages, build tools, and commands. Containerization makes this setup explicit through artifacts such as Dockerfiles, which are widely studied as software-engineering and DevOps artifacts [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] . Yet these artifacts remain difficult to write: developers report Docker and Docker-Compose specifications as time-consuming, while prior work observes that they often require system-administration knowledge and project-specific adaptation [ 5 , 2 , 6 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 环境搭建在成为一个基准测试抽象之前，首先是一个面向开发者的难题。 在开发者能够修改、测试或复现一个项目之前，他们必须先安装正确的语言运行时、系统软件包、构建工具和命令。 容器化通过 Dockerfile 等产物使这一搭建过程变得显式，这类产物作为软件工程和 DevOps 产物已被广泛研究 [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] 。 然而这些产物仍然难以编写：开发者反映 Docker 和 Docker-Compose 规格编写起来非常耗时，同时已有研究指出它们往往需要系统管理知识和针对项目的适配 [ 5 , 2 , 6 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods optimize their pipeline targeting the success rate alone. Yet time matters in both day-to-day development and large-scale automation. For a developer, each failed setup route blocks testing, reproduction, and validation until slow package installation, dependency resolution, or compilation commands finish [ 1 , 6 ] . At scale, recent pipelines build executable environments to train and evaluate coding agents [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] . Recent environment-construction systems further scale this process to tens of thousands or millions of environments [ 13 , 14 ] , where the per-instance build time becomes a first-order cost. We therefore treat the wall-clock time to build the environment as a first-class objective, posing the task as two goals at once: raise the success rate while cutting build time. To our knowledge, this is the first method to optimize the time cost of LLM-based environment construction rather than only report it.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法仅以成功率为目标来优化其流程。 然而在日常开发与大规模自动化中，时间同样重要。 对开发者而言，每条失败的搭建路径都会阻塞测试、复现与验证，直到缓慢的包安装、依赖解析或编译命令执行完毕 [ 1 , 6 ] 。 在大规模场景下，近期的研究流程会构建可执行环境来训练和评估编程智能体 [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] 。 近期的环境构建系统进一步将这一过程扩展到数万甚至数百万个环境 [ 13 , 14 ] ，此时每个实例的构建时间成为一阶成本。 因此，我们把构建环境的实际耗时作为一等目标，将任务同时定义为两个目标：在提高成功率的同时缩短构建时间。 据我们所知，这是首个优化基于大语言模型的环境构建时间成本、而非仅报告该成本的方法。

paragraphs.en: To see why this is hard, consider how current agents construct an environment. A typical system such as SWE-Builder [ 16 ] works in a loop: it inspects the repository’s files (manifests, READMEs, CI configs), drafts a setup script, runs it in a container, reads whatever error the run produces, and revises the script, often re-inspecting the repository, before trying again. It repeats this loop of analysis, execution, and diagnosis until the tests pass or a budget runs out. The loop is sequential: the agent issues one script, waits for it to finish, and only then learns whether it worked. This waiting is the structural bottleneck. A single installation command may still take as long as it takes, but the sequential loop makes every next decision depend on that command’s completion and failure.
paragraphs.zh: 要理解这件事为何困难，可以看看当前的智能体是如何构建环境的。 一个典型的系统，例如 SWE-Builder [ 16 ]，以循环方式工作：它检查仓库的文件（清单文件、README、CI 配置），起草一个安装脚本，在容器中运行它，读取运行产生的任何错误，然后修改脚本（往往会重新检查仓库），再重试。 它不断重复这一分析、执行与诊断的循环，直到测试通过或预算耗尽。 这个循环是串行的：智能体发出一个脚本，等待它运行结束，然后才能得知它是否成功。 这种等待正是结构性的瓶颈。 单条安装命令可能仍然需要那么长时间，但串行循环使得每一个后续决策都依赖于该命令的完成与失败结果。

No useful progress is possible until that first failure surfaces, and no repair is ready when it does.

paragraphs.en: SpecBuild turns this waiting into useful work. While the first round is still running, it predicts that the setup will fail for a missing Go toolchain and prepares the repair apk add --no-cache go on a parallel branch. The prediction is platform-aware: seeing an Alpine base image, the model installs with apk rather than apt , and it does so from reasoning alone, with no cached history. When the failure surfaces, the prepared branch already carries a working toolchain and is adopted directly, so the setup succeeds without a second round. The task finishes in 11.4 11.4 minutes, saving about 17 17 minutes over the sequential run, and the committed environment passes the same F2P check.

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 overviews the design. Given an input task, SpecBuild analyzes repository signals such as the snapshot, metadata, issue, and patch, and plans complementary setup routes. At the strategy level, these routes run as parallel branches. Each branch then follows the same iterative setup loop: plan a setup script, execute it in a container, and verify the resulting environment against the tests. Inside the execution step, command-level speculation runs the original command and a candidate repair in parallel. If the original command fails and the candidate repair succeeds, the repaired state is adopted immediately; otherwise the candidate repair is discarded. The first committed environment is returned, and the non-winning branches are discarded. This parallel breadth matches the structure of the problem: the configuration that builds is sparsely distributed across many routes, so exploring several at once reaches what a single sequential route cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 概述了该设计。 给定一个输入任务，SpecBuild 分析仓库信号（如快照、元数据、issue 和补丁），并规划互补的搭建路径。 在策略层面，这些路径作为并行分支运行。 每个分支随后遵循相同的迭代搭建循环：规划一个搭建脚本，在容器中执行它，并根据测试验证得到的环境。 在执行步骤内部，命令级推测会并行运行原始命令和一个候选修复。 如果原始命令失败而候选修复成功，则立即采用修复后的状态；否则丢弃该候选修复。 返回第一个提交的环境，并丢弃未胜出的分支。 这种并行广度与问题的结构相匹配：能够构建成功的配置稀疏地分布在众多路径之中，因此同时探索多条路径可以达到单条顺序路径无法企及的效果。

paragraphs.en: Strategy-level forking addresses uncertainty over which setup route will build the repository. Real repositories rarely document their exact environment, so several plausible configurations coexist and which one builds is revealed only by trying. A route is a setup direction: a base-image family, a runtime version, a package manager, and a dependency policy. For frostdb , three routes start from the official images golang:1.20-alpine , golang:1.19-bookworm , and golang:1.19-bullseye . Rather than guess a single route, SpecBuild speculates across them: it pursues several plausible routes in parallel and lets execution decide which one builds.
paragraphs.zh: 策略级分叉用于应对「哪条配置路线能成功构建仓库」的不确定性。 真实仓库很少记录其确切环境，因此多种合理的配置并存，只有尝试之后才能知道哪一种能构建成功。 路线是一个配置方向：包括基础镜像系列、运行时版本、包管理器和依赖策略。 对于 frostdb ，有三条路线分别从官方镜像 golang:1.20-alpine 、 golang:1.19-bookworm 和 golang:1.19-bullseye 出发。 SpecBuild 并不猜测单一路线，而是在多条路线间进行推测：它并行推进多条合理路线，让执行结果来决定哪一条能够构建成功。

paragraphs.en: Generating routes. An analysis phase reads the repository’s build signals, such as manifests, CI test commands, and project metadata, and summarizes them into a structured profile. Conditioned on this profile, SpecBuild plans a primary route , the setup direction most likely to build the repository, and, by reasoning about how that route could fail, such as a wrong base-image family, an incompatible runtime version, or a mismatched package manager or dependency policy, composes a small set of complementary routes that hedge those distinct failure modes. Because the primary and its hedges are planned together before any route runs, they cover different environment assumptions by construction rather than by chance, which is what distinguishes route racing from drawing independent samples (Section V-B ).

paragraphs.en: Racing to a winner. The branches run concurrently, bounded by a configurable budget of k k branches. The first committed environment is returned, and the remaining branches are cancelled and discarded. If no branch commits before all branches terminate or the task times out, no environment is submitted. No route is privileged, so a failure on any single one never stalls the task. This is where both gains originate: racing reaches a working configuration that a single route would miss, and it avoids the wall-clock a sequential agent spends exhausting dead ends one after another. Because the branches race, the first to commit cancels the rest: no branch runs past the moment of commit, and a route that hits a dead end is abandoned within a few rounds. The branch budget k k and the per-task speculation budget cap the total work, so racing explores breadth without unbounded cost; Section V-D analyzes the effect of the branch budget.

paragraphs.en: Within the execute step of that same loop, individual commands run one after another. Command-level forking addresses the uncertainty over whether a given command will fail, and turns the time spent running it, often minutes for an install or a compile, into preparation for its repair. The design rests on an asymmetry: a wrong guess costs only a millisecond-scale fork and one short, bounded repair attempt, whereas a right guess removes an entire round of failure, diagnosis, and retry. Because the downside is so much smaller than the upside, SpecBuild can speculate opportunistically. On frostdb , the execute step runs the build, and SpecBuild anticipates that it will fail for a missing Go toolchain.
paragraphs.zh: 在同一个循环的执行步骤中，各个命令依次运行。 命令级分叉解决了某个给定命令是否会失败的不确定性，并把运行它所花的时间（安装或编译往往需要数分钟）转化为对其修复的准备。 该设计基于一种不对称性：猜错只付出毫秒级的分叉代价和一次简短、有界的修复尝试，而猜对则省去整整一轮失败、诊断和重试。 由于下行风险远小于上行收益，SpecBuild 可以机会主义地进行推测。 在 frostdb 上，执行步骤运行构建，SpecBuild 预期它会因缺少 Go 工具链而失败。

paragraphs.en: Predicting failures. Before a command runs, SpecBuild queries an LLM with the repository, its language, the base-image family, and the command, and receives a structured prediction: a failure signature and class, a candidate fix, and a confidence score. For frostdb it predicts GO_MISSING and proposes apk add go . The choice is platform-aware: recognizing an Alpine base image, the model installs with apk rather than apt , and it does so from reasoning alone, with no cached history.
paragraphs.zh: 预测失败。 在命令运行之前，SpecBuild 会将仓库、其语言、基础镜像家族以及该命令一起提交给大语言模型查询，并获得一个结构化的预测结果：失败特征签名与类别、候选修复方案以及置信度评分。 对于 frostdb，它预测出 GO_MISSING，并提出 apk add go 这一修复方案。 这种选择是平台感知的：模型识别出 Alpine 基础镜像后，会使用 apk 而不是 apt 进行安装，而且这一判断完全来自推理本身，无需任何缓存的历史记录。

paragraphs.en: When to speculate. The value of speculation grows with a command’s running time and its chance of failing, so SpecBuild speculates only on setup-relevant commands such as dependency installation, building, and compilation, and skips trivial ones like cd or echo . A per-task budget bounds the number of predictions and their cost.

paragraphs.en: Speculative repair via fork-both. SpecBuild runs two attempts concurrently: one executes the original command, the other applies the predicted fix and then the command. If the original succeeds, the repair is discarded; if the original fails while the repair succeeds, the repair is adopted, sparing a full diagnose-and-retry round; if both fail, the speculative repair is discarded and the branch continues from the original failure feedback. A misprediction therefore merely wastes a bounded parallel attempt. This is why fork-both is preferable to acting on a prediction directly: the predicted fix is verified against the real command rather than trusted.
paragraphs.zh: 通过 fork-both 进行投机性修复。 SpecBuild 并发运行两次尝试：一个执行原始命令，另一个先应用预测的修复再执行命令。 如果原始尝试成功，则丢弃修复；如果原始尝试失败而修复成功，则采用修复，从而省去一整轮诊断与重试；如果两者都失败，则丢弃投机性修复，分支从原始失败的反馈继续。 因此，一次误预测只会浪费一次有界的并行尝试。 这正是 fork-both 优于直接依据预测行动的原因：预测的修复是针对真实命令进行验证的，而不是被直接信任。

paragraphs.en: The two granularities run under a single driver. Strategy-level forking launches the candidate routes as parallel branches and returns the first committed environment; each branch runs the plan, execute, and verify loop; and within a branch, risky commands may invoke command-level fork-both, which is the point where the two levels meet.
paragraphs.zh: 两种粒度在同一个驱动器下运行。 策略级分叉将候选路由作为并行分支启动，并返回第一个提交的环境；每个分支运行计划、执行和验证循环；而在分支内部，有风险的命令可能会调用命令级的双路分叉，这正是两个层级的交汇点。

paragraphs.en: Each branch follows its agent’s own checks and completion criteria when deciding whether to commit. paragraphs.en: We evaluate all methods on Multi-Docker-Eval [ 22 ] , a benchmark designed specifically for automated environment construction. It consists of 334 tasks drawn from 40 real-world repositories spanning 9 programming languages (C, C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, PHP, Python, Ruby, and Rust), each following the fail-to-pass criterion of Section II-A . This breadth of languages and build ecosystems within a single benchmark enables a controlled cross-language comparison under consistent evaluation conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Multi-Docker-Eval [ 22 ] 上评估所有方法，该基准专门为自动化环境构建而设计。 它由来自 40 个真实世界仓库的 334 个任务组成，涵盖 9 种编程语言（C、C++、Go、Java、JavaScript、PHP、Python、Ruby 和 Rust），每个任务都遵循第 II-A 节的 fail-to-pass 标准。 单一基准中涵盖如此广泛的语言和构建生态系统，使得在一致的评估条件下进行受控的跨语言比较成为可能。

paragraphs.en: We compare SpecBuild against four state-of-the-art environment-construction agents. Repo2Run [ 15 ] constructs executable Python environments from repository context; because it is Python-specific, we include it in the per-language analysis rather than the full multi-language comparison. RepoLaunch [ 17 ] automates dependency resolution, repository build, and test-result extraction across languages and platforms. SWE-Builder [ 16 ] inspects a repository, generates a setup script, runs it, and revises it from execution errors. MEnvAgent [ 18 ] retrieves environments from previously solved repositories, then reuses and patches them for a new project to avoid building from scratch. RQ2 further includes two ablation controls, Sequential (More Budget) and Best-of-N (Naive Parallel), to test whether the gains come from a larger sequential budget or from running independent workers in parallel.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 SpecBuild 与四个最先进的环境构建智能体进行比较。 Repo2Run [ 15 ] 从仓库上下文构建可执行的 Python 环境；由于它仅针对 Python，我们将其纳入按语言分析而非完整的多语言比较。 RepoLaunch [ 17 ] 跨语言和平台自动化依赖解析、仓库构建和测试结果提取。 SWE-Builder [ 16 ] 检查仓库、生成安装脚本、运行脚本，并根据执行错误进行修订。 MEnvAgent [ 18 ] 从先前已解决的仓库中检索环境，然后为新项目复用并修补这些环境，以避免从零开始构建。 RQ2 进一步包含两个消融对照——顺序执行（更多预算）和 Best-of-N（朴素并行），以检验收益是来自更大的顺序预算，还是来自并行运行多个独立的工作器。

paragraphs.en: Following Multi-Docker-Eval [ 22 ] , we report five metrics for each method.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Multi-Docker-Eval [ 22 ] 的做法，我们对每种方法报告五项指标。

paragraphs.en: Success Rate: the percentage of tasks whose constructed environment is verified as correct. Following Multi-Docker-Eval [ 22 ] , verification assesses whether the environment can execute the issue-related tests to reproduce the reported issue and validate its fix, as described in Section II-A .
paragraphs.zh: 成功率：所构建环境被验证为正确的任务所占的百分比。 遵循 Multi-Docker-Eval [ 22 ]，验证评估环境是否能够执行与问题相关的测试以重现所报告的问题并验证其修复方案，如第 II-A 节所述。

sents.en: Success Rate: the percentage of tasks whose constructed environment is verified as correct.
sents.zh: 成功率：所构建环境被验证为正确的任务所占的百分比。

sents.en: Following Multi-Docker-Eval [ 22 ] , verification assesses whether the environment can execute the issue-related tests to reproduce the reported issue and validate its fix, as described in Section II-A .
sents.zh: 遵循 Multi-Docker-Eval [ 22 ]，验证评估环境是否能够执行与问题相关的测试以重现所报告的问题并验证其修复方案，如第 II-A 节所述。

paragraphs.en: Commit Rate: the percentage of tasks for which the agent commits an environment for evaluation, a self-reported signal that the agent judged its setup ready; it does not require the environment to verify the change, so a high Commit Rate alone does not imply success.
paragraphs.zh: 提交率（Commit Rate）：智能体为评估提交环境的任务百分比，这是智能体自报的信号，表示其认为环境设置已就绪；它不要求环境验证更改，因此仅凭较高的提交率并不意味着成功。

paragraphs.en: Average Time: the average wall-clock time per task; our primary efficiency metric.
paragraphs.zh: 平均时间：每个任务的平均墙钟时间，这是我们主要的效率指标。

paragraphs.en: Token Consumption: the average input and output tokens used per task during environment construction.
paragraphs.zh: Token 消耗量：在环境构建过程中每个任务所使用的平均输入与输出 Token 数。

paragraphs.en: Average Cost: the average LLM API cost per task in US dollars.
paragraphs.zh: 平均成本：每个任务的平均 LLM API 成本（以美元计）。

paragraphs.en: SpecBuild is both faster and more successful. Across all three backbones, SpecBuild attains the highest Success Rate and the lowest average time of any method. Against the strongest baseline, MEnvAgent in every case, it raises the Success Rate from 24.5 % 24.5\% to 30.8 % 30.8\% on DeepSeek-v4-Flash, from 26.7 % 26.7\% to 38.0 % 38.0\% on MiMo-v2.5-Pro, and from 46.4 % 46.4\% to 58.4 % 58.4\% on GPT-5.5, a gain of 6.4 6.4 to 12.0 12.0 percentage points. At the same time it cuts average setup time from 48.0 48.0 to 28.0 28.0 , from 49.4 49.4 to 33.6 33.6 , and from 26.8 26.8 to 20.8 20.8 minutes respectively, a reduction of 22.4 % 22.4\% to 41.6 % 41.6\% . Both gains are statistically significant. On every backbone, the Success Rate improvement over the strongest baseline is significant under McNemar’s test [ 26 ] , and the setup-time reduction under the Wilcoxon signed-rank test [ 27 ] , each paired per task at p < 0.005 p<0.005 .
paragraphs.zh: SpecBuild 在速度和成功率上都更为出色。 在全部三个骨干模型上，SpecBuild 的成功率最高，平均耗时在所有方法中最低。 与最强的基线方法 MEnvAgent 相比，SpecBuild 在每种情况下都将成功率从 24.5 % 24.5\% 提升至 30.8 % 30.8\%（DeepSeek-v4-Flash）、从 26.7 % 26.7\% 提升至 38.0 % 38.0\%（MiMo-v2.5-Pro），以及从 46.4 % 46.4\% 提升至 58.4 % 58.4\%（GPT-5），提升幅度为 6.4 6.4 至 12.0 12.0 个百分点。 与此同时，它将平均环境搭建时间分别从 48.0 48.0 降至 28.0 28.0、从 49.4 49.4 降至 33.6 33.6，以及从 26.8 26.8 降至 20.8 20.8 分钟，降幅为 22.4 % 22.4\% 至 41.6 % 41.6\%。 这两项提升均在统计上显著。 在每个骨干模型上，相对最强基线的成功率提升在 McNemar 检验 [ 26 ] 下显著，环境搭建时间的缩短在 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 [ 27 ] 下显著，均按任务配对，p < 0.005 p<0.005。

paragraphs.en: The two goals do not trade off. No baseline is at once the fastest and the most successful: SWE-Builder and RepoLaunch are both slow and far less accurate, while MEnvAgent, the most successful baseline, remains much slower than SpecBuild . SpecBuild is the only method that leads on both axes, the direct payoff of replacing sequential exploration with parallel speculative exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个目标之间不存在权衡。 没有任何一个基线能同时做到最快和最成功：SWE-Builder 和 RepoLaunch 既慢且准确率低得多，而 MEnvAgent 作为最成功的基线，仍然比 SpecBuild 慢得多。 SpecBuild 是唯一在两个维度上都领先的方法，这正是用并行投机探索取代顺序探索所带来的直接收益。

paragraphs.en: Commit Rate reflects submission, not success. Commit Rate counts whether the agent submitted an environment it judged ready, which need not coincide with the environment actually working: on MiMo-v2.5-Pro, RepoLaunch commits more often ( 63.8 % 63.8\% ) than SpecBuild ( 56.9 % 56.9\% ) but verifies far fewer tasks ( 14.7 % 14.7\% versus 38.0 % 38.0\% Success Rate). We therefore report Commit Rate for completeness and read the Success Rate as the measure of success (Section V-C ).

paragraphs.en: Sequential (More Budget): the sequential agent with a larger budget, set to a comparable token-cost budget, ruling out that the gain comes merely from spending more.
paragraphs.zh: 顺序式（更多预算）：使用更大预算的顺序式智能体，将其设置为可比较的 token 成本预算，以排除增益仅仅来自花费更多这一可能性。

paragraphs.en: Best-of-N (Naive Parallel): five independent base-agent workers run in parallel, matching SpecBuild ’s maximum strategy budget, ruling out that the gain comes merely from running more workers.
paragraphs.zh: Best-of-N（朴素并行）：五个独立的基座智能体工作器并行运行，与 SpecBuild 的最大策略预算相匹配，排除了性能提升仅仅来自运行更多工作器的可能性。

paragraphs.en: The two levels play complementary roles. Adding strategy-level forking primarily improves success, raising the Success Rate from 22.2 % 22.2\% to 29.9 % 29.9\% , while also cutting average time from 57.4 57.4 to 32.7 32.7 minutes. This matches its purpose: strategy-level forking addresses route uncertainty by validating several problem-guided setup routes instead of spending the whole budget on one route. Adding command-level forking on top gives the full system, which further cuts average time to 28.0 28.0 minutes and raises Success Rate to 30.8 % 30.8\% . This matches its purpose as well: command-level forking addresses command-outcome uncertainty by preparing repairs before slow commands fail.
paragraphs.zh: 这两个层级发挥着互补的作用。 加入策略级分叉主要提升了成功率，将成功率从 22.2% 22.2\% 提高到 29.9% 29.9\%，同时将平均时间从 57.4 57.4 分钟缩短到 32.7 32.7 分钟。 这与其设计目的相符：策略级分叉通过验证多条由问题引导的搭建路线，而不是将全部预算花费在一条路线上，来解决路线不确定性问题。 在此基础上再加入命令级分叉即构成完整系统，该系统进一步将平均时间缩短到 28.0 28.0 分钟，并将成功率提高到 30.8% 30.8\%。 这同样与其设计目的相符：命令级分叉通过在缓慢的命令失败之前就准备好修复措施，来解决命令结果不确定性问题。

paragraphs.en: Naive parallelism is not enough. Could the gain be explained by parallelism alone? We build a Best-of-N control where each task launches five independent base-agent workers, matching SpecBuild ’s maximum strategy budget. As in SpecBuild , the first worker to commit a candidate environment determines the output. Best-of-N improves over the sequential agent, raising Success Rate from 22.2 % 22.2\% to 24.8 % 24.8\% and Commit Rate from 31.4 % 31.4\% to 35.3 % 35.3\% , showing that parallel sampling increases candidate coverage. paragraphs.en: This case study illustrates the command-level mechanism rather than the branch budget: we trace one branch to show how a prepared repair is validated by real execution and then adopted or discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 本案例研究展示的是命令级机制，而非分支预算：我们跟踪一个分支，以展示一个预先准备好的修复方案如何通过真实执行得到验证，进而被采纳或弃用。

paragraphs.en: A hit is an adopted branch, not a correct diagnosis. Figure 5 traces one rubyzip (Ruby) branch on the ruby:3.2-slim image, where bundle install fails while compiling a native gem extension. At each risky build, SpecBuild runs the original command and a candidate repair, a system-package install such as apt-get install zlib1g-dev , side by side and adopts whichever the build validates. The guess need not name the true cause: at each step the candidate repair runs in parallel with the original command, and the branch adopts whichever validates, converging to a working environment without a serial diagnose-and-retry detour; the third speculation is unnecessary, because the build succeeds on its own, and is discarded for the cost of a fork. Because adoption is decided by real execution rather than by the prediction, a wrong or unnecessary bet is discarded without ever changing the environment that is finally committed. This illustrates how an adopted repair removes a retry round while a discarded repair leaves the retained environment unchanged.

paragraphs.en: Headroom that grows with model capability. Because command-level speculation removes a round only when a prepared repair validates a failing command, the latency it hides grows with predictor quality. More accurate predictions create more opportunities to prepare successful repairs before the original commands fail. Ecosystems with canonical fixes, such as Go, already show what a strong predictor delivers, while more open-ended ones, such as Python, leave headroom that more capable backbones close. Command-level speculation therefore converts advances in model reasoning directly into faster setup, and stands to gain as backbone models improve. A perfect predictor would catch every recoverable failure and remove every corresponding round, the ceiling this mechanism approaches as models improve.

paragraphs.en: Command-level speculation is best seen not as a single heuristic but as a cheap, discardable bet with an asymmetric payoff: a prepared repair is adopted when real execution validates it and discarded otherwise, so correctness never depends on the guess. paragraphs.en: Speculation is most valuable when the setup process exposes long, uncertain commands with structured failure modes. Package installation, dependency resolution, compilation, and test preparation often take minutes before revealing a missing toolchain, a stale module graph, or an absent system library, recurring bottlenecks in environment construction and test-execution agents [ 1 , 22 , 6 ] . In such cases, a correct speculative branch can remove a full wait, diagnose, and retry round from the critical path. The largest gains therefore arise when commands are long enough to expose useful waiting time and when failure modes are regular enough for advance repair work to be validated. This gives a practical scheduling rule: speculate where there is enough latency and enough regularity to make advance work worth doing. This rule is also a deployment knob: where wall-clock latency dominates, the branch and speculation budgets control how much parallel exploration to spend, and SpecBuild sets this adaptively rather than by hand (Section V-D ).
paragraphs.zh: 当准备工作会暴露出具有结构化失败模式的长耗时、高不确定性命令时，投机执行最有价值。 软件包安装、依赖解析、编译以及测试准备往往在耗时数分钟后才暴露出缺失的工具链、过期的模块图或缺失的系统库，这些是环境构建与测试执行类智能体中反复出现的瓶颈 [ 1 , 22 , 6 ] 。 在这种情况下，一个正确的投机分支可以从关键路径中省去一整轮等待、诊断和重试。 因此，最大的收益出现在命令足够长、能暴露出有用的等待时间，且失败模式足够规律、使得提前修复工作能够得到验证的场景中。 这给出了一条实用的调度规则：在有足够延迟和足够规律性、使提前工作物有所值的地方进行投机执行。 这条规则同时也是一个部署旋钮：当墙钟时间延迟占主导地位时，分支和投机预算控制着投入多少并行探索，而 SpecBuild 会自适应地而非手动地设置这些预算（第 V-D 节）。

paragraphs.en: Strategy-level forking may look like simply running several setup attempts in parallel, but the advantage is not parallelism alone. Each branch is a distinct, problem-guided setup route rather than an interchangeable sample, and our ablation isolates the difference: at matched cost, route racing outperforms both a larger sequential budget and naive parallelism (Section V-B ). Where a sequential agent deepens a single setup attempt from execution feedback [ 15 , 1 , 16 ] , route racing selects the first route whose agent commits.
paragraphs.zh: 策略层面的分叉可能看起来只是并行运行多个初始化尝试，但其优势并不在于并行本身。 每个分支都是一条独特的、由问题引导的初始化路线，而非可互换的样本，我们的消融实验隔离出了这一差异：在相同成本下，路线竞速优于更大的串行预算和朴素的并行方式（第 V-B 节）。 串行智能体根据执行反馈深化单次初始化尝试 [15, 1, 16]，而路线竞速则选择首个其智能体提交的路线。

paragraphs.en: Command-level forking addresses a different source of latency. It does not race complete routes; it predicts that a running command is likely to fail and prepares a repair before the failure is observed. Together, the two granularities change the schedule of execution-driven setup: strategy-level forking broadens the search over routes, while command-level forking turns command waiting time into repair preparation. Both remain bounded by branch and speculation budgets, and both commit only work validated by real execution.
paragraphs.zh: 命令级分叉解决的是另一种延迟来源。 它并不竞速完整的路由；它预测一个正在运行的命令很可能失败，并在失败被观察到之前准备好修复。 两者结合改变了执行驱动的准备工作的调度方式：策略级分叉拓宽了对路由的搜索，而命令级分叉则把命令的等待时间转化为修复准备。 两者都受分支和投机预算的约束，并且都只提交经过真实执行验证的工作。

paragraphs.en: Internal validity. LLM-based agents can vary across model backends and runs, a common issue in recent software-engineering agent evaluations [ 19 , 20 ] . We control for this by evaluating all methods with the same benchmark, budget, execution harness, and validation scripts within each comparison, and by checking that the main conclusion holds across three backbone models. We also confirm the gains with paired significance tests (McNemar’s test for Success Rate [ 26 ] , Wilcoxon signed-rank for time [ 27 ] ; p < 0.005 p<0.005 ).
paragraphs.zh: 内部效度。 基于大语言模型的智能体在不同模型后端和不同运行之间会存在差异，这是近期软件工程智能体评估中的一个常见问题 [ 19 , 20 ] 。 我们通过以下方式对此加以控制：在每次对比中使用相同的基准测试、预算、执行框架和验证脚本来评估所有方法，并检验主要结论在三个骨干模型上均成立。 我们还通过配对显著性检验证实了这些增益（成功率采用 McNemar 检验 [ 26 ] ，时间采用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验 [ 27 ] ；p < 0.005 p<0.005 ）。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. Our two primary metrics match the paper’s objectives: F2P measures whether the environment verifies the patch, and wall-clock time measures setup latency. Following SWE-bench and Multi-Docker-Eval, F2P requires the tests to fail on the original code and pass after the gold patch [ 31 , 22 ] , the executable validation used by current SWE benchmarks and data pipelines [ 7 , 9 ] . We measure wall-clock time under identical hardware and matched concurrency, so infrastructure variation affects absolute times more than relative comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 构念效度。 我们的两大核心指标与论文目标相符：F2P 衡量环境是否验证了补丁，而挂钟时间衡量环境搭建的延迟。 沿用 SWE-bench 和 Multi-Docker-Eval 的做法，F2P 要求测试在原始代码上失败、在黄金补丁之后通过 [ 31 , 22 ] ，这是当前 SWE 基准和数据管线所使用的可执行验证方式 [ 7 , 9 ] 。 我们在相同硬件和匹配并发度下测量挂钟时间，因此基础设施差异对绝对时间的影响大于对相对比较的影响。

paragraphs.en: Speculation is a classic latency-hiding principle in computer systems: perform work that may be needed before its necessity is known, commit it when the prediction is validated, and discard it otherwise. This pattern appears in speculative computation and computer architecture [ 32 , 28 ] , thread-level speculation that executes likely future code in parallel [ 33 ] , and optimistic concurrency control that validates tentative work before committing it [ 34 ] . SpecBuild follows the same systems principle, but applies it to software environment construction: the speculative unit is an isolated build branch, and the validation signal is real execution.
paragraphs.zh: 投机（Speculation）是计算机系统中经典的延迟隐藏原则：在尚不确定其必要性之前就执行可能需要的工作，当预测被验证时将其提交，否则将其丢弃。 这一模式出现在投机计算与计算机体系结构 [32, 28]、并行执行可能未来代码的线程级投机 [33]，以及在实际提交前验证临时工作的乐观并发控制 [34] 中。 SpecBuild 遵循同样的系统原则，但将其应用于软件环境构建：投机的单元是一个隔离的构建分支，而验证信号是真实的执行。

paragraphs.en: Speculation has recently become central to LLM inference through speculative decoding [ 29 , 35 , 36 ] . A lightweight draft model proposes future tokens, the target model verifies them in parallel, accepted tokens are committed, and rejected tokens are discarded. Follow-up work improves this draft-and-verify loop with multiple decoding heads, feature-level drafting, and self-speculation [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] . More recent agent-serving work extends speculation beyond tokens, speculatively executing likely actions or tools to reduce the latency of sequential agent loops [ 30 , 40 , 41 ] . Closest to our latency-hiding goal, EAGER overlaps LLM code generation with interpreter execution to hide execution latency during code interpretation [ 42 ] .

paragraphs.en: Environment setup has long been a software-engineering and DevOps problem rather than only a benchmark artifact. Container specifications such as Dockerfiles are widely used and studied [ 3 , 2 , 4 ] , but developers still report Docker and Docker-Compose specifications as time-consuming and knowledge-intensive [ 5 , 6 ] . Prior work has therefore explored assistance for containerization, including dependency inference from source code [ 43 ] , Dockerfile generation from knowledge graphs [ 44 ] , Dockerfile completion [ 45 ] , base-image recommendation [ 46 ] , and Dockerfile generation for reproducible research [ 47 ] . These works help produce or recommend environment specifications; SpecBuild focuses on the execution-time process of finding a specification that actually passes validation.

paragraphs.en: Executable environments are also central to modern software-engineering automation. Benchmarks and training pipelines need tests that can run on real repositories [ 31 , 7 , 9 ] , and recent environment benchmarks and datasets scale this need across many repositories and languages [ 22 , 48 , 49 , 13 , 14 ] . To automate this process, Repo2Run [ 15 ] and ExecutionAgent [ 1 ] iteratively issue commands and refine setup scripts; SWE-Builder [ 16 ] automates environment construction inside an issue-resolution data pipeline; RepoLaunch [ 17 ] resolves dependencies, builds repositories, and extracts test results across languages and platforms; and MEnvAgent [ 18 ] reuses and patches retrieved environments instead of always rebuilding from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 可执行环境也是现代软件工程自动化的核心。 基准测试和训练流程需要能在真实代码库上运行的测试 [ 31 , 7 , 9 ] ，而近期的环境基准和数据集将这一需求扩展到了众多代码库和语言 [ 22 , 48 , 49 , 13 , 14 ] 。 为了自动化这一过程，Repo2Run [ 15 ] 和 ExecutionAgent [ 1 ] 迭代地发出命令并改进安装脚本；SWE-Builder [ 16 ] 在问题解决数据流水线中自动构建环境；RepoLaunch [ 17 ] 跨语言和平台解析依赖、构建代码库并提取测试结果；MEnvAgent [ 18 ] 则复用并修补检索到的环境，而不是总是从零开始重建。

paragraphs.en: These systems share the execution-driven style common to LLM agents for software engineering [ 19 , 20 , 50 , 51 ] : run an action, observe feedback, and decide the next step. SpecBuild keeps the same real-execution feedback, but changes the schedule: it explores alternative setup routes and likely failures while slow commands are still running. This turns waiting time into useful search, targeting both fail-to-pass success and wall-clock time.
paragraphs.zh: 这些系统共享软件工程中大语言模型智能体常见的执行驱动风格 [19, 20, 50, 51]：执行一个动作，观察反馈，然后决定下一步。 SpecBuild 保留了同样的真实执行反馈，但改变了调度方式：它在慢命令仍在运行时，探索其他设置路径和可能的失败情况。 这把等待时间转化为有用的搜索，同时兼顾从失败到成功的转化和实际耗时。

paragraphs.en: LLM-based environment setup remains slow and brittle because agents usually follow a sequential trial-and-error loop: they try one setup route, wait for slow commands to finish, and only then decide what to repair or try next. This paper introduced SpecBuild , which treats fail-to-pass success and wall-clock time as joint objectives and uses speculative forking to turn waiting time into useful parallel search. Speculative forking supports two granularities: strategy-level route exploration before execution and command-level repair preparation while the original command is still running. On Multi-Docker-Eval, covering 334 tasks from 40 repositories and 9 languages, SpecBuild improves the Success Rate by 6.4 to 12.0 percentage points over the strongest baseline while reducing average setup time by 22.4% to 41.6% across three backbone models. Speculative forking shows that LLM-based environment setup need not trade speed for reliability: exploring candidate branches in parallel and returning the first committed environment makes agents both faster and more successful.
